_comment: Settings applied to every unit in the batch, plus per-unit overrides. flash.ps1 POSTs this to /api/import, which is a partial merge, so anything omitted keeps its default and the baked WiFi row is never touched.

units._comment: Per-unit overrides, keyed by the -Unit argument. hostname is set automatically to clawdmeter-<Unit>; add entries here only for a unit that needs something different (a dimmer screen for a demo table, a rotated one for a shelf).
